title: Assessing variant effect predictors and disease mechanisms in intrinsically disordered proteins.
one_liner_zh: 该文系统评估了无序蛋白区域中致病变异分布及33种变异效应预测工具的性能，虽以IDR为对象并涉及互作相关机制，但核心是变异预测而非PPI机制建模，方法上无AI/物理模拟贡献。
abstract: Intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) are central to diverse cellular processes but present unique challenges for interpreting genetic variants implicated in human disease. Unlike structured protein domains, IDRs lack stable three-dimensional conformations and are often involved in regulation through transient interactions and post-translational modifications. These features can affect both the distribution of pathogenic variants and the performance of computational tools used to predict their effects. Here, we systematically assessed the distribution of pathogenic vs benign missense variants across disordered, intermediate, and structured protein regions in the human proteome. Pathogenic variants were notably depleted in IDRs yet were associated with distinct molecular mechanisms, particularly dominant gain- and loss-of-function effects. We evaluated 33 variant effect predictors (VEPs), revealing widespread reductions in sensitivity for pathogenic variants in IDRs, despite high AUROC scores driven by accurate benign variant predictions. We also observed substantial discordance among VEP classifications in disordered regions, underscoring the need for region-aware thresholds and disorder-informed prediction strategies. Incorporating features reflective of IDR biology, such as transient interaction motifs and modification sites, may enhance the accuracy and interpretability of future tools.
abstract_zh: 固有无序区域（IDRs）在多种细胞过程中至关重要，但为解读与人类疾病相关的遗传变异带来了独特挑战。与结构化蛋白结构域不同，IDRs缺乏稳定的三维构象，通常通过瞬时相互作用和翻译后修饰参与调控。这些特征可能影响致病性变异的分布以及用于预测其效应的计算工具的性能。在此，我们系统评估了人类蛋白质组中无序、中间和结构化蛋白区域内致病性与良性错义变异的分布。致病性变异在IDRs中显著减少，但关联着独特的分子机制，特别是显性功能获得和功能丧失效应。我们评估了33种变异效应预测器（VEPs），发现尽管高AUROC分数源于准确的良性变异预测，但IDRs中致病性变异的敏感性普遍降低。我们还观察到无序区域中VEP分类之间存在显著不一致性，强调了区域感知阈值和无序信息预测策略的必要性。整合反映IDR生物学的特征，如瞬时相互作用基序和修饰位点，可能提升未来工具的准确性和可解释性。
